title.narrative: Optimizing HIV investments for impact - Nigeria (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Nigeria, HIV, National Agency for the Control of AIDS (NACA)This program has the following goals: To ensure 90% of the population, including key and vulnerable populations, have access to HIV combination prevention interventions by 2022, and 95% by 2030. To reduce mortality and morbidity due to HIV/AIDS in Nigeria. To reduce the incidence of new HIV infection in Nigeria. The objectives of this program are: To ensure that 90% of people living with HIV know their status by 2022, and 95% by 2025. To reduce new HIV infections by 90% by 2025. To reduce mother-to-child transmission of HIV by 90% by 2025. To ensure that 90% of HIV positive persons are on sustainable antiretroviral therapy by 2022, and 95% by 2025. To ensure that 90% of HIV positive persons on antiretroviral therapy are virally suppressed by 2022, and 95% by 2025
